title: Love it
body: I’d like to extend a personal thanks to the developers of this app. It’s helped me so much. I used to go to sleep at 3 wake up at 12, forget to drink water until my lips were cracking, forget to brush my teeth multiple days, and I was just overall in a bad place. Finch really helped me get through that and become a better person. Thank you finch.
author: ksksksjjnbwia
